open_points.subject: operation_element_conclusion
open_points.text: then an approval of the element with status requested makes it wait with reason owner_approval and that approval_id — after an attempt resolved not_applied only one that counts for its resend (find_send_authority), whose attempt_number is greater than that attempt's
open_points.other_text: otherwise MUST return ApprovalAuthority for the oldest in store order of the element's approvals that count — for a resend after not_applied only those its behaviour note admits — read with ApprovalsOfElement, whose status is approved and whose request_digest equals the given request_digest
open_points.question: A requested approval cannot satisfy find_send_authority's definition of an approval that counts, which requires status approved; must operation_element_conclusion apply only the resend attempt-number cutoff to requested approvals, or must find_send_authority's counting rule include requested approvals?

open_points.subject: reach_operation_element
open_points.text: unless an approval of the element with status requested already exists — for a resend after not_applied only one that counts for it (find_send_authority), so a fresh approval is always requested after not_applied —
open_points.other_text: otherwise MUST return ApprovalAuthority for the oldest in store order of the element's approvals that count — for a resend after not_applied only those its behaviour note admits — read with ApprovalsOfElement, whose status is approved and whose request_digest equals the given request_digest
open_points.question: No requested approval can count under find_send_authority because that function requires status approved; must the existing-approval check use only find_send_authority's resend attempt-number cutoff, or must requested approvals be added to what find_send_authority considers counting?
